about: Task 129 (owner, 2026-11-02: a hand list): flat items and scenery that keep their game-view plane in world space when the camera flies or turns, instead of turning to face it. Keyed by FRM name; the value says why. The renderer draws such a card upright in the plane the art was drawn for, never edge-on to the game's own view, so a turn of up to 45 degrees skews it and a turn of 90 shows it edge-on, as a slab would be.

frms.njunk1.frm: a mattress lying on a floor, drawn as a slab with a pipe; a card that faces the camera reads as a billboard
frms.njunk7.frm: a mattress leaning on a wall, a slab with sides
frms.njunk2.frm: a slab leaning on a wall (a board or a mattress edge)
